_source: Zatara (Talaris) — verification probe of the shipped 6-mode lighting + orchestration-surfaces gallery
_doctrine: ADR-0018: everything visible in Ringer, in addition. Executed checks curl the LIVE here.now pages and gate on real served content — no trusting 'done'.

tasks.spec: Verification-only probe. Do NOT modify anything outside your task dir. Run: curl -fsS https://happy-aurora-tqr7.here.now/ and confirm the response is HTTP 200 and contains the text 'Agentic OS'. Write ./receipt.md recording the exact command, the HTTP status, and whether the marker was found. Done = receipt.md with a verification line.
tasks.check: curl -fsS https://happy-aurora-tqr7.here.now/ -o idx.html && grep -q 'Agentic OS' idx.html && echo 'GALLERY_INDEX_LIVE_OK'
tasks.verified: here.now gallery index returns 200 and contains 'Agentic OS'

tasks.spec: Verification-only probe. Do NOT modify anything outside your task dir. Fetch the published stylesheet https://happy-aurora-tqr7.here.now/shared/tokens.css and confirm ALL SIX lighting modes are served: data-theme selectors for dusk, twilight, hydroponics, forest, blueprint (plus the default Parchment). Write ./receipt.md with the command, which selectors were found, and a verification line. Done = receipt.md with a verification line.
tasks.check: curl -fsS https://happy-aurora-tqr7.here.now/shared/tokens.css -o t.css && grep -q 'data-theme="dusk"' t.css && grep -q 'data-theme="twilight"' t.css && grep -q 'data-theme="hydroponics"' t.css && grep -q 'data-theme="forest"' t.css && grep -q 'data-theme="blueprint"' t.css && echo 'SIX_MODE_LIGHTING_OK'
tasks.verified: published tokens.css serves all 6 data-theme lighting modes

tasks.spec: Verification-only probe. Do NOT modify anything outside your task dir. Fetch https://happy-aurora-tqr7.here.now/founder-cockpit/ and confirm the Orchestration Surfaces section is served (text 'Orchestration Surfaces' and a reference to 'Ringer' or 'Ringside'). Write ./receipt.md with the command, matches found, and a verification line. Done = receipt.md with a verification line.
tasks.check: curl -fsS https://happy-aurora-tqr7.here.now/founder-cockpit/ -o fc.html && grep -q 'Orchestration Surfaces' fc.html && grep -qE 'Ringer|Ringside' fc.html && echo 'ORCHESTRATION_SURFACES_OK'
tasks.verified: founder-cockpit serves the Orchestration Surfaces section referencing Ringer/Ringside
